topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I always knew I was more than just another face in the crowd, but when old甲 told me he doesn't remember me, it only solidified what I've always felt. It's strange, really, how someone can be so pivotal in my memories and yet be a complete non-entity in someone else's. Our laughter, the secrets, the promises—they were all mine to keep. It's almost liberating, in a way. I don't need his recognition to validate the chapters of my life he starred in, unknowingly. I've moved on, and my story, rich with or without his recollection, continues to unfold beautifully.
